description: Vercel AI SDK v7 structured object generation through OpenAI chat.
notes: generateObject is deprecated in ai 7.0.162, so the call is generateText with Output.object and a jsonSchema. ai 7.0.162 does not emit spans. Spans come from @ai-sdk/otel OpenTelemetry, passed on telemetry.integrations. Three spans: invoke_agent, agent_step, and chat. The model is openai.chat, and the SDK makes one call. Token counts are copied: input 24 and output 10.
